questions.stemHtml: A neonate presents with skin lesions that are streaky and whorled, primarily distributed along the trunk and limbs. These lesions are vesicular initially and later evolve into hyperpigmented lines as shown in the image below. A detailed family history reveals similar findings in female relatives.
